sources.entry: Swifka - Read-only Kafka monitor for safely inspecting topics, messages, and consumer state. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Ender-Wang/Swifka) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Swifka is a native macOS Kafka monitor that lets you browse topics, messages, consumer lag and broker health in a read-only way.
summary.what_it_does:
Swifka connects to Kafka-compatible clusters (Kafka, Redpanda, and others the README mentions) and shows topics, partitions, and messages with metadata. Messages can be decoded as UTF-8, Hex, Base64, Protobuf (with imported .proto files), Avro, or JSON, and Schema Registry integration auto-decodes Confluent wire-format messages. Consumer group lag is shown per partition and per member, alongside live and historical trend charts for throughput, lag, and ISR health stored in SQLite. Configurable alert rules cover ISR health, cluster lag, broker latency, and broker offline, with macOS notifications. The README says the app is read-only: the KafkaService exposes no produce, delete, or admin operations.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="how_to_run">["brew install --cask ender-wang/tap/swifka", "Or download the latest .dmg from Releases"]
use_cases: monitor kafka consumer lag on a mac
browse topics and messages without risk of writes
inspect protobuf or avro messages from a schema registry
give on-call engineers a safe read-only kafka view
watch broker health and ISR trends
export kafka chart data to Excel
how_to_run: Or download the latest .dmg from Releases
notable: Read-only by design: KafkaService exposes only read methods, with no produce, delete, or admin operations
Native macOS app built with SwiftUI and an @Observable state model, rather than Java or web
Decodes Confluent Schema Registry wire-format messages (Protobuf, Avro, JSON)
Alert rules for ISR health, cluster lag, broker latency and broker offline, with history and macOS notifications
Custom JSON-based localization with English and Simplified Chinese, plus in-app DMG auto-update with checksum verification
caveats: Requires macOS 15.7+ and Xcode 16.2+ to build from source
Monitoring only: it cannot produce, delete, or administer topics
README does not state a Linux or Windows version
